title: Brijuni Crowds by Month: When to Avoid Them in 2027
metaDescription: Brijuni crowd levels month by month, with the quietest times to visit, ticket price drops, and tips for dodging tour groups at Veliki Brijun.
content:
## How Crowded Is Brijuni Month by Month?

Brijuni National Park is a group of 14 islands off the Istrian coast. Visitors get there on the park's own boat from Fažana, a crossing of about 15 minutes. Most visitors go to Veliki Brijun, the only large island open for tours. The fixed boat slots, the tourist train and the small visitor area make crowding easy to notice on busy days.

### January to March: Very Quiet

These are the emptiest months. Few tour buses arrive and the island feels close to empty. Boat departures are less frequent, so check the schedule at the park office at Brionska 10 before you go. The adult ticket is €35. Some facilities have limited hours.

### April and May: Moderate, With School Groups

Spring brings organised school and coach groups, mostly on weekday mornings. Weekends in May are noticeably busier than the same days in April. The ticket is still €35. For quiet conditions, pick a weekday afternoon slot.

### June: Busy and Getting Pricier

The summer fare of €50 starts on 1 June. In high season, ferries run almost hourly from early morning to late afternoon. Early June is calmer than late June, because cruise-ship and package-tour traffic builds toward July.

### July and August: Peak Season

These are the most crowded months. Boats fill up, the train circuit runs with full carriages, and the Fažana waterfront is busy. Book ahead for the guided excursion, which runs on a fixed four-hour slot. This is the period to avoid if crowds bother you.

### September: Busy, Then Easing

The first half of September is still at high-season levels. The €50 fare holds through 30 September. Crowds drop steadily in the last ten days of the month.

### October to December: Low

The price falls to €35 on 1 October, so moving a visit by a few days saves €15 per adult. October is the best balance of open services and thin crowds. November and December are very quiet.

## Best Times to Avoid the Crowds

- **Best overall for few people:** October, and April outside school-trip days.
- **Quietest:** November to March.
- **If you must go in summer:** choose early June or the last week of September.
- **Day of week:** Tuesday to Thursday is usually calmer than Friday to Sunday.
- **Time of day:** take the first boat of the day, or the evening option. In high season the park sells a self-guided entry from 6pm for €15, which avoids the daytime tour groups.

## Ticket Prices That Affect Crowd Planning

Prices below are the 2026 tariff; 2027 prices were not yet published, so check np-brijuni.hr.

| Ticket | Oct–May | Jun–Sep |
|---|---|---|
| Guided excursion, adult | €35 | €50 |
| Guided, student or 65+ | €30 | €40 |
| Guided, child 7–18 | €15 | €20 |
| Self-guided (app), adult | €30 | €40 |

Children under 7 go free. The ticket covers the return boat, guide, tourist train, safari park and museum displays.

## Insider Tips for Quieter Visits

- The 6pm self-guided entry in summer is the cheapest and calmest way to see the island. It gives a shorter visit, so it suits repeat visitors better than first-timers.
- Private or small-boat panorama tours from Fažana (from about €15 for short trips, €35 for glass-bottom boats) show the islands from the water. They avoid the on-island train crowds but do not replace the landing.
- Sunset dolphin trips leave Fažana at around 18:00 and are small groups, often capped at 15 people.
- Day trips from Pula add a longer boat ride and often arrive at the same time as the Fažana groups.
- Skipping July and August is worth more than any other step. Paying €50 to stand in a queue for the train is poor value compared with a €35 October visit.

## Getting There

Fažana is about 8 km from Pula. The park ticket office is at Brionska 10, near the departure pier. Parking in Fažana fills early on summer mornings, so arrive well before the first boat.

faq.question: What is the busiest month in Brijuni?
faq.answer: July and August are the busiest months. Boats and the tourist train are fullest then, and the adult ticket is at the €50 summer rate. Advance booking is strongly advised.

faq.question: What is the quietest time to visit Brijuni?
faq.answer: November to March is the quietest period, with very few visitors and a €35 adult ticket. October is the best choice if you want thin crowds with services still fully running.

faq.question: Is Brijuni crowded in September?
faq.answer: The first half of September is still busy and priced at €50. Crowds ease in the last week, and the fare drops to €35 on 1 October.

faq.question: How can I avoid crowds in Brijuni in summer?
faq.answer: Take the first boat from Fažana, go on a weekday, or buy the €15 self-guided entry from 6pm. Early June and late September are also calmer than July and August.

quickAnswer: Brijuni is busiest from July to August, with June and September close behind. November to March is the quietest period, when few visitors come and tickets cost €35. April, May and October are moderately busy. Visit on weekdays and take the first boat from Fažana to avoid the biggest groups.
